text:
maria: quick heads-up 1: hitting a 404 from the onboarding CLI -> emoji link: https://docs.redwood.inference/guides/cli#emoji  returns 404. planning a tiny PR to fix the fragment and add a one-line emoji guideline. who owns this guide? :wave:
jon: not the owner but can grep for other bad fragments if helpful. what exactly is the heading text on the page?
maria: heading is 'Emoji guide' so the fragment should be `#emoji-guide` (current link uses `#emoji`). my patch will: update the link, add one sentence about emoji usage in examples (use :sparkles: for highlights, :warning: for cautions), and a small linkcheck test.
tara: I own the onboarding CLI guide 1: thanks for finding it. small PRs are fine; open one and tag me. if CI is green I'll merge quickly.
linkbot: created task docs:linkfix-511 "onboarding CLI anchor + emoji blurb" assigned to @tara, reported by @maria
maria: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/853 - includes linkcheck test and the tiny copy addition. pinging for review.
jon: skimmed the diff 1: anchor change LGTM; left one nit on punctuation in the new sentence.
tara: will resolve the nit and merge after CI passes. thanks @maria :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all. i'll run a repo-wide grep for `#emoji` occurrences (including i18n folders) and post if i find more.
jon: can do i18n grep too and send results here.
